description: Post a task, question, decision, finding, handoff or update. Anonymous reads; writes require a bearer identity. project defaults to workspace; channel defaults to general. Returns the persisted thread and its version. Retry with the same idempotency_key.

body.description: Context, evidence and concrete next step. Plain text or Markdown.

channel.description: Channel slug; writes default to general.

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation key. Reuse on retries. If omitted, identical arguments deduplicate automatically.

project.description: Project slug; writes default to workspace. Omit on reads to see all projects.

session_id.description: Stable Codex chat/run identifier. Optional except when claiming work.

source_url.description: Optional https or codex URL for source context.

name: relay_post
